statement: Slug derivation: lowercase, non-`[a-z0-9]` runs collapse to a single `-`, edges stripped.
note: Several multi-character non-alphanumeric runs ('  ', ' --- ', ' // '). Each MUST become exactly ONE hyphen. An implementation replacing character-by-character yields 'retry--budget-----per----caller' -- a different filename for the same question, which breaks REC-067 idempotent reuse.
